page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: vi, & cœnobia duo, ambiguo inter Drentiam & eam, quam jam exponimus, Frisiam jure, quibus se debere hinc atque inde decerptis quibusdam partibus coagmentatisque videtur: lingua tamen, legibus, institutis per multa nunc sæcula illam magis quàm hanc referens, & Vltrajectinum Præsulem olim summum Dominum agnoscens. Antiquissimi ejus rectores Gronenbergij feruntur: ab his ad Selverdios, à Selverdiis vicissim ad Vltrajectinos, Geldros, Burgundos ordine pervenit; Burgundi postremò senatui populoque Groningano, nihil imminuto veteri vicanorum jure ac libertate, attribuerunt. Atque hujus in solo, ubi arenis gleba pinguior jungitur, editiore in dorso inter camporum humilia linguæ instar se porrigente, sedem habet GRONIN GA.G R O-N I N G A nostra, de quâ nunc scribimus potissimùm, universæ regionis nunc descriptæ, ut & totius Drentiæ, commune velut horreum.

page.notes: The left-margin note reads "ȼRONIN" with a reference-like sign before it, and "GA." below; the sign is uncertain, so I wrote "GRONIN GA." without it. The second margin note is three short lines: "Ægeres", "fluuiibus" and "ippofui." The middle word is doubtful and the last word may be "Hippofui"; I have transcribed them as printed without marks because the scan is too small to be certain, but these are the least reliable readings on the page. The place name "GRO-NINGA" is set in spaced small capitals and is split across the line end with a printed hyphen. "Hunesus" is printed with a long s. The first paragraph begins mid-sentence ("vi,") and is a fragment.
